summary: The J. David Gladstone Institutes' Mission Bay headquarters at 1650 Owens Street: a six-story, roughly 200,000-sq-ft biomedical research building for this UCSF-affiliated independent nonprofit, dedicated in December 2004. A roughly 105,000-sq-ft, $160M expansion at the same address was announced in 2023 but is not confirmed complete.
